title: Per-slot CNode initialisation split on original_cap_at
intent: Reduce the per-slot CNode-initialisation theorem -- a Hoare triple that init_cnode_slot ... Move turns a half-initialised slot into an initialised slot -- to a case split on whether the slot holds an original capability, dispatching each branch to one of two framed separation-logic lemmas already proved for exactly that case.

parent.name: init_cnode_slot_move_sep
parent.statement:
lemma init_cnode_slot_move_sep:
  "\<lbrakk>well_formed spec; cnode_at obj_id spec;cap_at (\<lambda>c. is_device_cap c = dev) (obj_id, slot) spec\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
   \<lbrace>\<guillemotleft>cnode_slot_half_initialised spec t obj_id slot \<and>*
     si_obj_cap_at t orig_caps spec dev obj_id slot \<and>*
     si_spec_irq_cap_at irq_caps spec obj_id slot \<and>*
     si_cap_at t dup_caps spec dev obj_id \<and>*
     object_fields_empty spec t obj_id \<and>* si_objects \<and>* R\<guillemotright> \<rbrace>
   init_cnode_slot spec orig_caps dup_caps irq_caps Move obj_id slot
   \<lbrace>\<lambda>_.\<guillemotleft>object_slot_initialised spec t obj_id slot \<and>*
        si_spec_obj_null_cap_at t orig_caps spec obj_id slot \<and>*
        si_spec_irq_null_cap_at irq_caps spec obj_id slot \<and>*
        si_cap_at t dup_caps spec dev obj_id \<and>*
        object_fields_empty spec t obj_id \<and>* si_objects \<and>* R\<guillemotright>\<rbrace>"

children.name: init_cnode_slot_move_not_original_sep
children.statement:
lemma init_cnode_slot_move_not_original_sep:
  "\<lbrakk>well_formed spec; cnode_at obj_id spec;
    \<not> original_cap_at (obj_id, slot) spec\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
   \<lbrace>\<guillemotleft>cnode_slot_half_initialised spec t obj_id slot \<and>*
     si_obj_cap_at t orig_caps spec dev obj_id slot \<and>*
     si_spec_irq_cap_at irq_caps spec obj_id slot \<and>*
     si_cap_at t dup_caps spec dev obj_id \<and>*
     object_fields_empty spec t obj_id \<and>* si_objects \<and>* R\<guillemotright> \<rbrace>
   init_cnode_slot spec orig_caps dup_caps irq_caps Move obj_id slot
   \<lbrace>\<lambda>_.\<guillemotleft>object_slot_initialised spec t obj_id slot \<and>*
        si_spec_obj_null_cap_at t orig_caps spec obj_id slot \<and>*
        si_spec_irq_null_cap_at irq_caps spec obj_id slot \<and>*
        si_cap_at t dup_caps spec dev obj_id \<and>*
        object_fields_empty spec t obj_id \<and>* si_objects \<and>* R\<guillemotright>\<rbrace>"
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The no-original-capability branch: the slot is left untouched, so the half-initialised and null-cap/initialised predicates coincide and the frame is preserved.

applicability.goal_shape: a Hoare triple over init_cnode_slot spec orig_caps dup_caps irq_caps Move obj_id slot whose precondition is the separating conjunction cnode_slot_half_initialised ... ∧* si_obj_cap_at ... ∧* si_spec_irq_cap_at ... ∧* si_cap_at ... ∧* object_fields_empty ... ∧* si_objects ∧* R and whose postcondition is the same frame with object_slot_initialised and the null-cap predicates substituted, under the premises well_formed spec, cnode_at obj_id spec and cap_at (λc. is_device_cap c = dev) (obj_id, slot) spec.
applicability.use_when: the program's behaviour branches on a single boolean predicate of the spec (here original_cap_at (obj_id, slot) spec); one framed lemma already exists for each branch, stated with that predicate (or its negation) as an extra premise and with the same pre/post frame; and the two branch lemmas together cover the predicate, so wp can select them and discharge the split with no other work.
applicability.avoid_when: the two branches need different frames or different generalisations (then wp against the branch lemmas will not close the split goal); the predicate is not exhaustive over the domain (then case_tac leaves a third case); or the branch lemmas have not been proved yet.

metrics.how_counted: glue_lines = lines 1215-1231 of InitCSpace_SI.thy (the full parent lemma; the glue itself is the three lines 1228-1230, case_tac plus two wp applications); direct_lemmas = the two named lemmas the glue applies; depth = the longest project-lemma chain init_cnode_slot_move_sep -> init_cnode_slot_move_original_sep -> seL4_CNode_Mutate_object_slot_initialised_sep -> seL4_CNode_Mutate_object_slot_initialised_sep_helper; children_closed_by_automation = both children close by wp/clarsimp (the original child after its own inner case split)

consequences: The case split on a boolean predicate creates exactly two goals (predicate holds / does not hold) plus an exhaustiveness obligation, which case_tac on a boolean discharges itself because the predicate is either true or false; no separate original_cap_at ... ∨ ¬ original_cap_at ... lemma is stated. The two branch lemmas must each carry the discriminating predicate as a premise so that wp can select them; if a branch needed the predicate to be derived rather than assumed, the wp dispatch would not close. The original branch is itself a second-level split on the shape of the spec cap (NullCap / None / cap_has_object / is_irqhandler_cap), so that side of the decomposition is two layers deep and its leaves are the seL4 object-slot lemmas.
